author: CrashCourse
description:
Was the 2020 election stolen? Well, no. But a lot of people seemed to think it was. 
So, how hard is it, really, to commit election fraud? In this episode, we dig into how our voting system really works, and how we keep our elections secure. 

Chapter 1 - Introduction: The January 6th Insurrection 00:00
Chapter 2 - Voter Fraud 01:08
Chapter 3 - How are elections secured? 03:54
Chapter 4 - Does voter fraud happen? 09:36
Chapter 5 - Misinformation about elections 10:53
Chapter 6 - Review & Credits 12:06

Sources: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1naWmymw68W9x6GAix9e4jTrEIRXT0-F3IniP3LSscOo/edit?tab=t.0

For supplemental resources related to the topics covered in this episode, check out: https://usafacts.org/crash-course/election-integrity
